lockFileMaintenance.description: Label the weekly whole-tree refresh so it is distinguishable from a targeted update. The release-age hold is nulled here: regeneration lets cargo pick transitive versions, so the hold cannot be enforced and would sit pending on nearly every run. Green required checks automerge the refresh; a red one stays open for diagnosis.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: minimumReleaseAge restates Renovate's own default for this block; without it the 3-day hold above reads as applying to security fixes.

packageRules.description: Update the lockfile within compatible cargo ranges; replace ranges for incompatible releases.
Hold major upgrades for dashboard approval and process them after lower-risk updates.
Treat GitHub-owned actions as platform dependencies and automerge patch, pin, and digest updates after required checks pass.
Automerge third-party action patch and pin updates; require manual review when a pinned tag moves to a new digest.

Exempt action digest updates from the release-age hold. The hold earns its keep against a newly published version that has not been in the wild long enough to be trusted. A digest update is not that: it re-pins an action to the commit its already-pinned major tag now names, which is the version this repo has been trusting by tag all along. Holding it only means carrying a knowingly stale pin for three days and occupying a prConcurrentLimit slot while it waits.
Automerge stable cargo patch updates; keep pre-1.0 updates manual.

customManagers.description: Track annotated version pins in workflows and composite action files: a renovate comment above a version key. File patterns are the customManagers:githubActionsVersions preset's verbatim, because the preset would double-claim these annotations.
